The site is Southgate. I replied in your thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

The source is the 2025-09-03 carrier API outage. Priyanka wrote that label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4. She later noted that Southgate cleared the backlog and labels printed again, and the incident closed that evening.
